summary: Describes playbooks as a repeatable, reusable configuration management and multi-machine deployment system that can declare configs, orchestrate ordered processes, and run tasks synchronously or asynchronously.
questions: When should I write a playbook instead of running ad hoc commands?

answer_card.title: Why use playbooks
answer_card.answer_md: If you'll run something more than once, write a playbook and keep it in source control. Playbooks let you declare configurations, orchestrate ordered steps across sets of machines, and launch tasks synchronously or asynchronously.
